verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises debugging/troubleshooting via natural language and issue triage (gh-3, gh-12, gh-20), and some users praise its large-context codebase navigation (comm-1, comm-12). However, multiple hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing at basic function calling, and being poor at codebase navigation and agentic debugging tasks (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-15), directly contradicting the vendor's debugging claims.
